desc:
Welcome to Catalog Color! Create cool new avatars by searching for any item on the catalog. Save your outfits, browse the catalog, chat with other users, and just have fun!

With the concert hall, you can walk the runway like a model, tell jokes to an audience, and give a singing concert to other users.

Premium players will get access to beta features.

Features:
🎩 Access the full Roblox catalog
🖌️ Sort items by color or category
⭐ Favorite items you love
👒 Browse hundreds of pre-made outfits to inspire you
🎭 Try every emote and roleplay with other users
🚶 View each character animation
🔊 Voice chat with other users
🎶 Perform on the runway stage
📷 Take a selfie
➕ And so much more!

Updates:
- New map!
- Bugfixes
- Better catalog functionality
